summary: A recommendation engine and creator economy AI can feed, but not yet replace.
moat: TikTok's moat is a recommendation system trained on enormous real-time behavioral signals plus a creator economy of humans performing for an audience. AI can generate clips, but the platform's value is the feedback loop between authentic creators, live cultural trends, and a ranking model that keeps attention — a network effect that generated video alone does not supply.

challengers.name: AI-generated short-form video tools
challengers.evidence: Generative video models can produce clips on demand, but rank no personalized feed and hold no creator/audience network.
